test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held On: 27 June, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the natural port of India from the following.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mumbai**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Natural Harbor** occurs where land and water converge in such a way as to protect ships from wind and waves as they enter and dock.
 
• They are typically formed typically in bays, estuaries, and river mouths.
 
• **Mumbai Port**
 
 
• Mumbai is the** largest natural port** in India.
 
• It is India’s largest port by size and shipping traffic.
 
• It is located in **west Mumbai on the western coast** of India.
 
• It allows easy docking and passage for large cargo ships.
 
• It handles numerous imports and exports, including crude and petroleum oil, as well as liquid chemicals, etc.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chennai Port **is one of the oldest ports on the eastern coast.

 
 
• It is an **artificial harbour** built-in 1859.
 
• It is not much suitable for large ships because of the shallow waters near the coast.
 
• Tamil Nadu and Puducherry are its hinterlands.
 
 
 
• **Kolkata Port** is located on the **Hugli river,** 128 km inland from the Bay of Bengal.
 
 
• Kolkata Port is also confronted with the problem of silt accumulation in the Hugli river which provides a link to the sea.
 
• Its hinterland covers U.P., Bihar, Jharkhand, West Bengal, Sikkim and the north-eastern states.
 
• Apart from this, it also extends ports facilities to our neighbouring land-locked countries such as Nepal and Bhutan.
 
 
 
• **Deendayal Port,** also known as **Kandla Port**, is one of the major ports in India, situated in the state of Gujarat.
 
 
• It was established in 1950 and has been functioning for over 70 years.
 
• It is a permanent port and has been operating for several decades.
 
• It is a tidal port, meaning the water level in the port area fluctuates with the tides.
